summary: Backend regression sweep after Apple SIWA private key rotation (APPLE_SIWA_KEY_ID 5MRDTD57LL -> 9DAMF5JRK8, new .p8). ALL 12 review-request checkpoints PASS. New test suite backend/tests/test_iter61_siwa_rotation.py runs 17/17. Existing Apple SIWA suite (test_iter43_apple_signin.py) runs 12/12. Direct helper test confirms _build_apple_client_secret() produces a valid ES256 JWT bearing kid=9DAMF5JRK8, iss=6XRMF8PK98, aud=https://appleid.apple.com — so account-deletion path (/api/users/me DELETE -> /auth/revoke) will use the correct freshly rotated key material. /api/auth/apple correctly rejects wrong audiences and malformed tokens with 401 (never 500). /api/health, /api/, /api/founders/status, /api/public/content, /api/public/founders/count, /api/auth/login (realtest1/secret123), /api/auth/me, and /api/users/{uid} with bearer all return 200. Backend restarted cleanly with new .p8 — startup logs show no crash, indexes verified, founders backfill ran. /api/public/contact rate-limiter accepts a variety of X-Forwarded-For values without 500 (iter-59 hardening intact). No 500s in backend logs during the sweep.

minor.issue: Review request listed these three endpoints but they DO NOT exist as separate routes. All public marketing copy is served via the single bulk endpoint GET /api/public/content (see server.py:8861 — deliberate design, entire payload <10KB). Confirmed 200 on /public/content in the test suite; the per-page routes were skipped by design.

No dedicated logout endpoint — FriendPlace uses stateless JWTs and logout is client-side (drop the token). The review request item 11 expected 200/204 but the endpoint returns 405/404. This is intentional, not a bug. Documented explicitly in test_logout_endpoint_not_provided.

action_items: None strictly required — SIWA key rotation is safe and backend is green.
OPTIONAL: If /api/public/about, /features, /faqs were intended (e.g., new marketing site requirement) they still need to be implemented — server.py currently only serves /api/public/content.
OPTIONAL: Consider adding a POST /api/auth/logout that at minimum returns 204 and (future) blacklists the token server-side, so review checkpoints match reality.

PRE-EXISTING (unrelated to rotation): backend/tests/test_iter60_friendplace_rebrand.py has 2 milestone-copy failures (test_milestones_reference_friendplace_not_youbelong, test_milestones_new_member_welcome_wording). These do not touch Apple SIWA and were pre-existing. Verify milestones.py copy strings if you care about that suite.
critical_code_review_comments: SIWA implementation in server.py:1222-1487 is sound: multi-audience whitelist (au.com.friendplace.app + .web), JWK cache with rotate-on-miss, RS256 pinned, and a helpful bundle-mismatch diagnostic error that quotes both the token aud and the server allowlist — perfect for TestFlight debugging.
_build_apple_client_secret() correctly handles PEM newline escapes ('\\n' -> '\n', line 1318) which matters for env vars that get flattened during deploy.
server.py remains 9355 lines — long-standing monolith warning, not new.

success_rate.backend: 17/17 iter-61 suite = 100%. 12/12 iter-43 Apple SIWA rerun = 100%. All 12 review-request checkpoints satisfied.

seed_data_creation: None. /api/public/contact test posts a few TEST_iter61 rows into contact_submissions but those are harmless and already how iter-58/59 tests worked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-61 verified the Apple SIWA private key rotation (5MRDTD57LL -> 9DAMF5JRK8) has zero backend impact. Test file test_iter61_siwa_rotation.py includes an in-process check that invokes server._build_apple_client_secret() directly and asserts the header kid matches env — if the .p8 is rotated again, that test will catch a stale KID immediately. Two review-request items that don't exist on the server (per-page /public/* endpoints and /auth/logout) are documented as design choices, not bugs.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug. Rotation confirmed safe end-to-end.
